text: EX-10.3 4 exhibit103-8xk.htm EX-10.3 Document Exhibit 10.3 Execution Version DATE 13 November 2026 International Paper Company as the IP Guarantor National Westminster Bank Plc as the Facility Agent IP Guarantee Relating to a €1,350,000,000 senior term and revolving facilities agreement Macfarlanes LLP | 20 Cursitor Street, London EC4A 1LT | macfarlanes.com T +44 (0)20 7831 9222 | F +44 (0)20 7831 9607 | DX 138 Chancery Lane Contents Clause Page 1 Interpretation 1 2 Facilities Agreement 2 3 Guarantee and indemnity 3 4 Preservation of rights 3 5 Representations and warranties 5 6 Undertakings 7 7 Remedies and waivers 8 8 General 8 9 Termination 9 10 Governing law 9 11 Enforcement 9 12 USA Patriot Act 10 13 Waiver of jury trial 10 Date 13 November 2026 Parties 1 INTERNATIONAL PAPER COMPANY , a New York corporation with registration number 53310 whose principal place of business is at 6400 Poplar Avenue, Memphis, TN 38197, United States (the “ IP Guarantor "); and 2 NATIONAL WESTMINSTER BANK PLC as facility agent acting for itself and on behalf of the Finance Parties (as defined in the Facilities Agreement) (in this capacity the " Facility Agent "). Background The IP Guarantor and the Facility Agent each enter into this IP Guarantee in connection with the Facilities Agreement. Agreement 1 Interpretation 1.1 Definitions In this IP Guarantee (including in the recitals hereto) the following words have the following meanings: Anti-corruption Laws : the United States Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 and the UK Bribery Act of 2010. Code : the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended from time to time. Company : DS Smith Limited, a private limited company incorporated in England and Wales with registration number 01377658. ERISA : the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended from time to time. ERISA Affiliate : any corporation or trade or business which is a member of the same controlled group of corporations (within the meaning of Section 414(b) of the Code) as the IP Guarantor or is under common control (within the meaning of Section 414(c) of the Code) with the IP Guarantor. Facilities Agreement : the €1,350,000,000 term and revolving credit facilities agreement entered into on or around the date of this IP Guarantee and made between, among others, the Company and the Facility Agent (as amended and/or restated from time to time). Governmental Authority : the government of the United States of America or any other nation, or any political subdivision thereof, whether state or local, and any agency, authority, instrumentality, regulatory body, court, central bank or other entity exercising executive, legislative, judicial, taxing, regulatory or administrative powers or functions of or pertaining to government and any group or body charged with setting financial accounting or regulatory capital rules or standards (including, without limitation, the Financial Accounting Standards Board, the Bank for International Settlements or the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or any successor or similar authority to any of the foregoing and any supra-national bodies such as the European Union or the European Central Bank). IP Group : the IP Guarantor and its Subsidiaries from time to time. Material Adverse Effect : any event occurs which (taking into account the resources available to the IP Group (including funds, insurance and other claims and indemnities) without breaching the terms of this IP Guarantee) has a material adverse effect on the business, 1 financial condition or assets of the IP Group taken as a whole which materially and adversely affects the ability of the IP Guarantor to perform its payment obligations under this IP Guarantee. Multiemployer Plan : a multiemployer plan defined as such in Section 3(37) of ERISA to which contributions have been made by the IP Guarantor or any ERISA Affiliate of it and which is covered by Title IV of ERISA. Party : a party to this IP Guarantee. PBGC : the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation or any entity succeeding to any or all of its functions under ERISA. Person : any natural person, corporation, limited liability company, trust, joint venture, association, company, partnership, Governmental Authority or other entity. Plan : any employee benefit or other plan established or maintained by the IP Guarantor or any ERISA Affiliate of it and which is covered by Title IV of ERISA, other than a Multiemployer Plan. Separation Effective Date : the meaning given to that term in the Facilities Agreement. 1.2 Construction 1.2.1 Capitalised terms defined in the Facilities Agreement have, unless expressly defined otherwise in this IP Guarantee, the same meaning in this IP Guarantee. 1.2.2 In this IP Guarantee any reference to a "Clause" is, unless the context otherwise requires, a reference to a Clause of this IP Guarantee. 1.2.3 The provisions of clauses 1.2 ( Construction ), 11.5 ( Default interest ), 14 ( Taxes ), 17 ( Payments ), 22.8(b) ( Exclusion of liability ), 22.10 ( Information ), 22.17 ( Amounts paid in error ), 23 ( Evidence and calculations ), 25.1 ( Currency indemnity ), 27 ( Amendments and waivers ), 30 ( Set-off ), 31 ( Pro rata sharing ), 32 ( Severability ), 33 ( Bail-in ) and 35 ( Notices ) of the Facilities Agreement apply to this IP Guarantee as though they were set out in full in this IP Guarantee mutatis mutandis (without duplication of amounts paid by the Obligor pursuant to clause 14 ( Taxes ) of the Facilities Agreement), except that in each of those provisions (and any defined terms used in those provisions) references to: (i) the or this “Agreement” are to be construed as references to this IP Guarantee; and (ii) the “Company”, an “Obligor” and/or a “Party” (as applicable) are to be construed as references to the IP Guarantor. 1.2.4 The Parties intend this document to take effect as a deed notwithstanding the fact that a Party may only execute this document under hand. 1.3 Third party rights Save in respect of the Finance Parties, a person who is not a party to this IP Guarantee has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce or to enjoy the benefit of any term of this IP Guarantee. 2 Facilities Agreement The IP Guarantor confirms that it has been provided with a copy of the Facilities Agreement prior to execution of this IP Guarantee and acknowledges the terms of the Facilities Agreement (including, without limitation, the definitions, rules of interpretation, currency and funds of payment, manner of appropriation and application of payments and the provisions regulating the sharing of payments between the Finance Parties). 2 3 Guarantee and indemnity Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date, the IP Guarantor irrevocably and unconditionally: 3.1.1 guarantees to the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) punctual performance by each Borrower of all that Borrower’s obligations under the Finance Documents; 3.1.2 undertakes with the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) that whenever a Borrower does not pay any amount when due under or in connection with any Finance Document, the IP Guarantor shall immediately on demand pay that amount as if it was the principal obligor; and 3.1.3 agrees with the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) that if any obligation guaranteed by it is or becomes unenforceable, invalid or illegal, it will, as an independent and primary obligation, indemnify the Facility Agent or that other Finance Party (as applicable) immediately on demand against any cost, loss or liability it incurs as a result of a Borrower not paying any amount which would, but for such unenforceability, invalidity or illegality, have been payable by it under any Finance Document on the date when it would have been due. The amount payable by the IP Guarantor under this indemnity will not exceed the amount it would have had to pay under this Clause 3 if the amount claimed had been recoverable on the basis of a guarantee. 4 Preservation of rights 4.1 Continuing guarantee This guarantee is a continuing guarantee and will extend to the ultimate balance of sums payable by any Obligor under the Finance Documents, regardless of any intermediate payment or discharge in whole or in part. 4.2 Reinstatement If any discharge, release or arrangement (whether in respect of the obligations of any Obligor or any security for those obligations or otherwise) is made by a Finance Party in whole or in part on the basis of any payment, security or other disposition which is avoided or must be restored in insolvency, liquidation, administration or otherwise, without limitation, then the liability of the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee will continue or be reinstated as if the discharge, release or arrangement had not occurred. 4.3 Waiver of defences The obligations of the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee will not be affected by an act, omission, matter or thing which, but for this IP Guarantee, would reduce, release or prejudice any of its obligations under this IP Guarantee (without limitation and whether or not known to it or any Finance Party), including: 4.3.1 any time, waiver or consent granted to, or composition with, any Obligor or other person; 4.3.2 the release of any Obligor or any other person under the terms of any composition or arrangement with any creditor of any member of the Group; 4.3.3 the taking, variation, compromise, exchange, renewal or release of, or refusal or neglect to perfect, take up or enforce, any rights against, or security over assets of, any Obligor or other person or any non-presentation or non-observance of any formality or other requirement in respect of any instrument or any failure to realise the full value of any security; 3 4.3.4 any incapacity or lack of power, authority or legal personality of or dissolution or change in the members or status of any Obligor or any other person; 4.3.5 any amendment, novation, supplement, extension, restatement (however fundamental and whether or not more onerous) or replacement of any Finance Document or any other document or security including without limitation any change in the purpose of, any extension of or any increase in any facility or the addition of any new facility under any Finance Document or other document or security; 4.3.6 any unenforceability, illegality or invalidity of any obligation of any person under any Finance Document or any other document or security; or 4.3.7 any insolvency or similar proceedings. 4.4 Immediate recourse The IP Guarantor waives any right it may have of first requiring the Facility Agent or any other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) to proceed against or enforce any other rights or security or claim payment from any person before claiming from the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee. This waiver applies irrespective of any law or any provision of a Finance Document to the contrary. 4.5 Appropriations Until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full (and, for the avoidance of doubt, notwithstanding the occurrence of the Separation Effective Date if it occurs prior to such payment in full), the Facility Agent and each other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) may: 4.5.1 refrain from applying or enforcing any other moneys, security or rights held or received by the Facility Agent or that other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) in respect of those amounts, or apply and enforce the same in such manner and order as it sees fit (whether against those amounts or otherwise) and the IP Guarantor shall not be entitled to the benefit of the same; and 4.5.2 hold in an interest-bearing suspense account any moneys received from the IP Guarantor, or on account of the IP Guarantor’s liability, in each case, under this IP Guarantee. 4.6 Deferral of the IP Guarantor’s rights Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date (or if earlier, until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full), the IP Guarantor will not exercise any rights which it may have by reason of performance by it of its obligations under this IP Guarantee or by reason of any amount being payable, or liability arising, under this IP Guarantee: 4.6.1 to be indemnified by an Obligor; 4.6.2 to claim any contribution from any other guarantor of any Obligor’s obligations under the Finance Documents; 4.6.3 to take the benefit (in whole or in part and whether by way of subrogation or otherwise) of any rights of the Finance Parties under the Finance Documents or of any other guarantee or security taken pursuant to, or in connection with, the Finance Documents by any Finance Party; 4 4.6.4 to bring legal or other proceedings for an order requiring any Obligor to make any payment, or perform any obligation, in respect of which the IP Guarantor has given a guarantee, undertaking or indemnity under Clause 3 ( Guarantee and indemnity ); 4.6.5 to exercise any right of set-off against any Obligor; and/or 4.6.6 to claim or prove as a creditor of any Obligor in competition with any Finance Party. Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date (or if earlier, until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full), if the IP Guarantor receives any benefit, payment or distribution in relation to such rights it shall hold that benefit, payment or distribution to the extent necessary to enable all amounts which may be or become payable to the Finance Parties by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents to be repaid in full on trust for the Finance Parties and shall promptly pay or transfer the same to the Facility Agent or as the Facility Agent may direct for application in accordance with clause 17 ( Payments ) of the Facilities Agreement. 4.7 Additional guarantee This IP Guarantee is in addition to and is not in any way prejudiced by any other guarantee or security now or subsequently held by any Finance Party. 5 Representations and warranties 5.1 Representations and warranties The IP Guarantor makes the representations and warranties set out in this Clause 5 to the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of the other Finance Parties). 5.2 Status (R) It is a corporation duly incorporated and validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of its incorporation, possessing perpetual corporate existence and the capacity to sue and be sued in its own name, and it has the power to own its property and assets and carry on its business as it is now being conducted. It is duly qualified and is licensed and, as applicable, in good standing under the laws of each jurisdiction (other than its jurisdiction of incorporation) where its ownership, lease or operation of properties or the conduct of its business requires such qualification or license, except to the extent that failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.3 Power and authority (R) It has the power to enter into and perform its obligations under this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby and has taken all necessary action to authorise the entry into and performance of its obligations under this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby. 5.4 Legal validity (R) This IP Guarantee constitutes (subject to the Legal Reservations) its legal, valid and binding obligations enforceable in accordance with its terms. 5.5 Non-conflict with laws (R) The entry into and performance by it of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby do not and will not conflict with: 5.5.1 any law or regulation applicable to it; 5 5.5.2 its certificate of incorporation, bylaws or other constitutional documents; or 5.5.3 any agreement or document to which it is a party or which is binding upon it or any of its assets in a manner which is material in the context of this IP Guarantee. 5.6 No default (R) The entry into and performance of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby will not cause an Event of Default to occur. 5.7 Consents All authorisations required in connection with the entry into, performance, validity and enforceability of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby have been obtained or effected and are in full force and effect. 5.8 Governing law and enforcement (R) Subject to the qualifications as to matters of law only expressed in any legal opinion delivered to the Facility Agent pursuant to paragraph (d) of the definition of Legal Reservations: 5.8.1 the choice of English law as the governing law of this IP Guarantee will be recognised and enforced in its jurisdiction of incorporation; and 5.8.2 any judgment obtained in England in relation to this IP Guarantee will be recognised and enforced in its jurisdiction of incorporation. 5.9 Litigation (R) No litigation, arbitration or administrative proceedings (including any relating to Environmental Laws) are current or pending or, to its knowledge, threatened, which are reasonably likely to be adversely determined and which, if so determined, are reasonably likely to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.10 Sanctions 5.10.1 Neither it nor any director, officer or, to the knowledge of the IP Guarantor, any of its employees or representatives in their capacity as such is a Restricted Party. 5.10.2 The IP Guarantor has instituted and maintains policies and procedures designed to promote compliance with Sanctions applicable to it and its business. 5.11 Anti-corruption The IP Guarantor conducts its businesses in compliance with applicable Anti-corruption Laws and has instituted and maintains policies and procedures designed to promote and achieve compliance with such laws. 5.12 ERISA Except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect, the IP Guarantor and its ERISA Affiliates have fulfilled their respective obligations under the minimum funding standards of ERISA and the Code with respect to each Plan and are in compliance in all material respects with the applicable provisions of ERISA and the Code, and have not incurred any liability to the PBGC or any Plan or Multiemployer Plan (other than to make contributions or scheduled payments in the ordinary course of business) which, when taken together with all other such liabilities incurred, would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. 6 5.13 Investment Company Act It is not an "investment company", or a company "controlled" by an "investment company", within the meaning of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended from time to time. 5.14 Times for making representations 5.14.1 The representations set out in this Clause 5 are made by the IP Guarantor on the date of this IP Guarantee. 5.14.2 Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date, the representations and warranties set out in Clauses 5.2 ( Status ) to 5.6 ( No default ) and Clauses 5.8 ( Governing law and enforcement ) and 5.9 ( Litigation ) (and marked for ease of reference with “ (R) ”) shall be deemed to be repeated on the date of delivery of each Request, on each Utilisation Date, on any Accordion Effective Date and on the first day of each Interest Period, with reference to the facts and circumstances then subsisting, as if made at each such time. 5.14.3 When a representation is repeated, it is applied to the circumstances existing at the time of repetition. 6 Undertakings 6.1 Duration The undertakings in this Clause 6 shall remain in force from and after the date of this IP Guarantee until (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date. 6.2 Compliance with laws The IP Guarantor shall comply with all laws to which it is subject, if failure so to comply would have a Material Adverse Effect. 6.3 Pari passu ranking The IP Guarantor undertakes that its obligations under this IP Guarantee will rank at least pari passu in right of priority and payment with all its other present and future unsecured and unsubordinated obligations other than those obligations which are mandatorily preferred by law and not by reason of contract. 6.4 Maintenance of corporate existence The IP Guarantor shall do all such things as are necessary to maintain its corporate existence. 6.5 Know your customer requirements 6.5.1 Subject to Clause 6.5.2 below, the IP Guarantor must promptly on the request of any Finance Party (via the Facility Agent) supply to the Facility Agent (for that Finance Party) any documentation or other evidence which is reasonably requested by that Finance Party (whether for itself, on behalf of any Finance Party or any prospective new Lender) (via the Facility Agent) to enable a Finance Party or prospective new Lender to carry out and be satisfied with the results of all applicable know your customer requirements. 6.5.2 The IP Guarantor shall only be required to supply any information under Clause 6.5.1 above if the necessary information is not already available to the relevant Finance Party and the requirement arises as a result of: 6.5.2.1 the introduction of any change in (or in the interpretation, administration or application of) any law or regulation made after the date of this IP Guarantee; or 7 6.5.2.2 a proposed assignment or transfer by a Lender of any of its rights and/or obligations under the Facilities Agreement to a person that is not a Lender before that assignment or transfer. 6.6 Sanctions and anti-corruption 6.6.1 The IP Guarantor will conduct its business in material compliance with Anti- corruption Laws and Sanctions and will be subject to policies and procedures instituted and maintained by it designed to promote and achieve compliance with such laws. 6.6.2 Any provision in this Clause 6.6 and any provision in Clause 5.10 ( Sanctions ) shall not apply to or in favour of any person if and to the extent that it would result in a breach, by or in respect of that person, of any applicable Blocking Law. 6.6.3 For the purpose of this Clause 6.6, " Blocking Law " means: 6.6.3.1 any provision of Council Regulation (EC) No. 2271/1996 of 22 November 1996 (or any law or regulation implementing such Regulation in any member state of the European Union); 6.6.3.2 any provision of Council Regulation (EC) No. 2271/1996 of 22 November 1996, as it forms part of domestic law of the United Kingdom; or 6.6.3.3 Section 7 of the German Foreign Trade Regulation ( Außenwirtschaftsverordnung ). 7 Remedies and waivers No failure to exercise, nor any delay in exercising, on the part of any Finance Party, any right or remedy under this IP Guarantee shall operate as a waiver, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right or remedy prevent any further or other exercise or the exercise of any other right or remedy. The rights and remedies provided in this IP Guarantee are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights or remedies provided by law. 8 General 8.1 Assignment 8.1.1 Subject to the provisions of the Facilities Agreement, the Facility Agent may assign and transfer all or any of its rights and obligations under this IP Guarantee. The IP Guarantor shall not be entitled to assign or transfer all or any of its rights, benefits and obligations under this IP Guarantee without the consent of the Facility Agent (acting on the instructions of each Lender). 8.1.2 Any reference in this IP Guarantee to a Lender includes a New Lender but excludes a Lender if no amount is or may be owed to or by it under the Facilities Agreement and its Commitment has been cancelled or reduced to nil. 8.2 Amendments Any amendment to this IP Guarantee must be made in writing and signed by each Party. 8.3 Counterparts This IP Guarantee may be executed in any number of counterparts, and this has the same effect as if the signatures on the counterparts were on a single copy of this IP Guarantee. 8 9 Termination Notwithstanding any other term of this IP Guarantee, with effect upon, from (and including) the Separation Effective Date: 9.1 this IP Guarantee shall automatically, irrevocably and unconditionally terminate (without giving rise to any liabilities of or for the IP Guarantor as a result of such termination) and shall be discharged and cease to be in effect; and 9.2 all of the obligations, liabilities and claims (whether contingent or continuing and including any that have or may have arisen prior to the Separation Effective Date) of or against the IP Guarantor under the terms of, or in connection with, this IP Guarantee shall automatically, irrevocably and unconditionally be terminated, discharged and released (and by countersigning this IP Guarantee, the Facility Agent hereby acknowledges and accepts this Clause 9.2 on behalf of itself and each other Finance Party), provided that Clauses 1.3 ( Third party rights ), 4.5 ( Appropriations ), 10 ( Governing law ), 11 ( Enforcement ) and 13 ( Waiver of jury trial ) shall survive and continue in full force and effect notwithstanding the termination of the other provisions of this IP Guarantee in accordance with this Clause 9 and provided further that in no event shall the IP Guarantor have any obligations or liabilities thereunder or pursuant thereto. For the avoidance of doubt, this Clause 9 is without prejudice to any obligation or liabilities of any Obligor and any claim any Finance Party may have against any Obligor from time to time in accordance with the terms of any Finance Document. 10 Governing law This IP Guarantee and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it are governed by English law. 11 Enforcement 11.1 Jurisdiction 11.1.1 The English courts have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute including a dispute relating to any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with this IP Guarantee. 11.1.2 The English courts are the most appropriate and convenient courts to settle any such dispute and the IP Guarantor waives objection to those courts on the grounds of inconvenient forum or otherwise in relation to proceedings in connection with this IP Guarantee. 11.1.3 This Clause 11.1 is for the benefit of the Finance Parties only. To the extent allowed by law, a Finance Party may take: 11.1.3.1 proceedings in any other court; and 11.1.3.2 concurrent proceedings in any number of jurisdictions. 11.2 Service of process 11.2.1 Without prejudice to any other mode of service allowed under any relevant law, the IP Guarantor: 11.2.1.1 irrevocably appoints International Paper UK Holdings Limited as its agent for service of process in relation to any proceedings before the English courts in connection with this IP Guarantee; and 9 11.2.1.2 agrees that failure by an agent for service of process to notify the IP Guarantor of the process will not invalidate the proceedings concerned. 11.2.2 If any person appointed as process agent is unable for any reason to act as agent for service of process, the IP Guarantor must (provided the Separation Effective Date has not at such time occurred) promptly appoint another agent on terms acceptable to the Facility Agent. Failing this, the Facility Agent may appoint another agent for this purpose. 12 USA Patriot Act 12.1.1 The Facility Agent (on behalf of each Lender that is subject to the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation) hereby notifies the IP Guarantor that, pursuant to the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable, such Lender is required to obtain, verify and record information that identifies the IP Guarantor, which information includes the name and address of the IP Guarantor and other information that will allow such Lender to identify the IP Guarantor in accordance with the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable. The IP Guarantor agrees that it will provide the Facility Agent (on behalf of each Lender) with such information as the relevant Lender may reasonably request in order for such Lender to satisfy the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable. 12.1.2 In this Clause 12: 12.1.2.1 “ Beneficial Ownership Regulation ” means 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230. 12.1.2.2 “ USA Patriot Act ” means the Uniting and Strengthening America by Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism Act of 2001, Public Law 107-56. 13 Waiver of jury trial EACH PARTY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A JURY TRIAL OF ANY CLAIM OR CAUSE OF ACTION IN CONNECTION WITH THIS IP GUARANTEE OR ANY TRANSACTION CONTEMPLATED BY THIS IP GUARANTEE. THIS IP GUARANTEE MAY BE FILED AS A WRITTEN CONSENT TO TRIAL BY COURT. Executed and delivered as a deed on the date stated at the beginning of this IP Guarantee. 10 SIGNATURES THE IP GUARANTOR EXECUTED as a DEED by ) INTERNATIONAL PAPER ) COMPANY , and signed and delivered ) /s/ [***] as a deed on its behalf by ) [***] in the presence of: Witness Signature: /s/ [***] Name: [***] Address: 6400 Poplar Ave T4, 7-441 Memphis, TN 38197 Occupation: [***] [Project Diamond – IP Guarantee (SFA) Signature Page] FACILITY AGENT EXECUTED as a DEED by ) NATIONAL WESTMINSTER BANK ) PLC , and signed and delivered as a ) /s/ [***] deed on its behalf by ) [***] in the presence of: Witness Signature: /s/ [***] Name: [***] Address: Flat 42, Geoffrey House Pardoner Street SE1 4DW Occupation: [***] [Project Diamond – IP Guarantee (SFA) Signature Page]

text: EX-10.4 5 exhibit104-8xk.htm EX-10.4 Document Exhibit 10.4 Execution Version Date 13 November 2026 International Paper Company as the IP Guarantor National Westminster Bank Plc as the Facility Agent IP Guarantee Relating to a €1,550,000,000 bridge facility agreement Macfarlanes LLP | 20 Cursitor Street, London EC4A 1LT | macfarlanes.com T +44 (0)20 7831 9222 | F +44 (0)20 7831 9607 | DX 138 Chancery Lane Contents Clause Page 1 Interpretation 1 2 Facility Agreement 2 3 Guarantee and indemnity 3 4 Preservation of rights 3 5 Representations and warranties 5 6 Undertakings 7 7 Remedies and waivers 8 8 General 8 9 Termination 9 10 Governing law 9 11 Enforcement 9 12 USA Patriot Act 10 13 Waiver of jury trial 10 Date 13 November 2026 Parties 1 INTERNATIONAL PAPER COMPANY , a New York corporation with registration number 53310 whose principal place of business is at 6400 Poplar Avenue, Memphis, TN 38197, United States (the “ IP Guarantor "); and 2 NATIONAL WESTMINSTER BANK PLC as facility agent acting for itself and on behalf of the Finance Parties (as defined in the Facility Agreement) (in this capacity the " Facility Agent "). Background The IP Guarantor and the Facility Agent each enter into this IP Guarantee in connection with the Facility Agreement. Agreement 1 Interpretation 1.1 Definitions In this IP Guarantee (including in the recitals hereto) the following words have the following meanings: Anti-corruption Laws : the United States Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 and the UK Bribery Act of 2010. Code : the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended from time to time. Company : DS Smith Limited, a private limited company incorporated in England and Wales with registration number 01377658. ERISA : the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended from time to time. ERISA Affiliate : any corporation or trade or business which is a member of the same controlled group of corporations (within the meaning of Section 414(b) of the Code) as the IP Guarantor or is under common control (within the meaning of Section 414(c) of the Code) with the IP Guarantor. Facility Agreement : the €1,550,000,000 bridge facility agreement entered into on or around the date of this IP Guarantee and made between, among others, the Company and the Facility Agent (as amended and/or restated from time to time). Governmental Authority : the government of the United States of America or any other nation, or any political subdivision thereof, whether state or local, and any agency, authority, instrumentality, regulatory body, court, central bank or other entity exercising executive, legislative, judicial, taxing, regulatory or administrative powers or functions of or pertaining to government and any group or body charged with setting financial accounting or regulatory capital rules or standards (including, without limitation, the Financial Accounting Standards Board, the Bank for International Settlements or the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or any successor or similar authority to any of the foregoing and any supra-national bodies such as the European Union or the European Central Bank). IP Group : the IP Guarantor and its Subsidiaries from time to time. Material Adverse Effect : any event occurs which (taking into account the resources available to the IP Group (including funds, insurance and other claims and indemnities) without breaching the terms of this IP Guarantee) has a material adverse effect on the business, 1 financial condition or assets of the IP Group taken as a whole which materially and adversely affects the ability of the IP Guarantor to perform its payment obligations under this IP Guarantee. Multiemployer Plan : a multiemployer plan defined as such in Section 3(37) of ERISA to which contributions have been made by the IP Guarantor or any ERISA Affiliate of it and which is covered by Title IV of ERISA. Party : a party to this IP Guarantee. PBGC : the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation or any entity succeeding to any or all of its functions under ERISA. Person : any natural person, corporation, limited liability company, trust, joint venture, association, company, partnership, Governmental Authority or other entity. Plan : any employee benefit or other plan established or maintained by the IP Guarantor or any ERISA Affiliate of it and which is covered by Title IV of ERISA, other than a Multiemployer Plan. Separation Effective Date : the meaning given to that term in the Facility Agreement. 1.2 Construction 1.2.1 Capitalised terms defined in the Facility Agreement have, unless expressly defined otherwise in this IP Guarantee, the same meaning in this IP Guarantee. 1.2.2 In this IP Guarantee any reference to a "Clause" is, unless the context otherwise requires, a reference to a Clause of this IP Guarantee. 1.2.3 The provisions of clauses 1.2 ( Construction ), 8.3 ( Default interest ), 11 ( Taxes ), 14 ( Payments ), 19.8(b) ( Exclusion of liability ), 19.10 ( Information ), 19.17 ( Amounts paid in error ), 20 ( Evidence and calculations ), 22.1 ( Currency indemnity ), 24 ( Amendments and waivers ), 27 ( Set-off ), 28 ( Pro rata sharing ), 29 ( Severability ), 30 ( Bail-in ) and 32 ( Notices ) of the Facility Agreement apply to this IP Guarantee as though they were set out in full in this IP Guarantee mutatis mutandis (without duplication of amounts paid by the Obligor pursuant to clause 11 ( Taxes ) of the Facility Agreement), except that in each of those provisions (and any defined terms used in those provisions) references to: (i) the or this “Agreement” are to be construed as references to this IP Guarantee; and (ii) the “Company”, an “Obligor” and/or a “Party” (as applicable) are to be construed as references to the IP Guarantor. 1.2.4 The Parties intend this document to take effect as a deed notwithstanding the fact that a Party may only execute this document under hand. 1.3 Third party rights Save in respect of the Finance Parties, a person who is not a party to this IP Guarantee has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce or to enjoy the benefit of any term of this IP Guarantee. 2 Facility Agreement The IP Guarantor confirms that it has been provided with a copy of the Facility Agreement prior to execution of this IP Guarantee and acknowledges the terms of the Facility Agreement (including, without limitation, the definitions, rules of interpretation, currency and funds of payment, manner of appropriation and application of payments and the provisions regulating the sharing of payments between the Finance Parties). 2 3 Guarantee and indemnity Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date, the IP Guarantor irrevocably and unconditionally: 3.1.1 guarantees to the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) punctual performance by the Borrower of all the Borrower’s obligations under the Finance Documents; 3.1.2 undertakes with the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) that whenever the Borrower does not pay any amount when due under or in connection with any Finance Document, the IP Guarantor shall immediately on demand pay that amount as if it was the principal obligor; and 3.1.3 agrees with the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of each other Finance Party) that if any obligation guaranteed by it is or becomes unenforceable, invalid or illegal, it will, as an independent and primary obligation, indemnify the Facility Agent or that other Finance Party (as applicable) immediately on demand against any cost, loss or liability it incurs as a result of the Borrower not paying any amount which would, but for such unenforceability, invalidity or illegality, have been payable by it under any Finance Document on the date when it would have been due. The amount payable by the IP Guarantor under this indemnity will not exceed the amount it would have had to pay under this Clause 3 if the amount claimed had been recoverable on the basis of a guarantee. 4 Preservation of rights 4.1 Continuing guarantee This guarantee is a continuing guarantee and will extend to the ultimate balance of sums payable by any Obligor under the Finance Documents, regardless of any intermediate payment or discharge in whole or in part. 4.2 Reinstatement If any discharge, release or arrangement (whether in respect of the obligations of any Obligor or any security for those obligations or otherwise) is made by a Finance Party in whole or in part on the basis of any payment, security or other disposition which is avoided or must be restored in insolvency, liquidation, administration or otherwise, without limitation, then the liability of the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee will continue or be reinstated as if the discharge, release or arrangement had not occurred. 4.3 Waiver of defences The obligations of the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee will not be affected by an act, omission, matter or thing which, but for this IP Guarantee, would reduce, release or prejudice any of its obligations under this IP Guarantee (without limitation and whether or not known to it or any Finance Party), including: 4.3.1 any time, waiver or consent granted to, or composition with, any Obligor or other person; 4.3.2 the release of any Obligor or any other person under the terms of any composition or arrangement with any creditor of any member of the Group; 4.3.3 the taking, variation, compromise, exchange, renewal or release of, or refusal or neglect to perfect, take up or enforce, any rights against, or security over assets of, any Obligor or other person or any non-presentation or non-observance of any formality or other requirement in respect of any instrument or any failure to realise the full value of any security; 3 4.3.4 any incapacity or lack of power, authority or legal personality of or dissolution or change in the members or status of any Obligor or any other person; 4.3.5 any amendment, novation, supplement, extension, restatement (however fundamental and whether or not more onerous) or replacement of any Finance Document or any other document or security including without limitation any change in the purpose of, any extension of or any increase in any facility or the addition of any new facility under any Finance Document or other document or security; 4.3.6 any unenforceability, illegality or invalidity of any obligation of any person under any Finance Document or any other document or security; or 4.3.7 any insolvency or similar proceedings. 4.4 Immediate recourse The IP Guarantor waives any right it may have of first requiring the Facility Agent or any other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) to proceed against or enforce any other rights or security or claim payment from any person before claiming from the IP Guarantor under this IP Guarantee. This waiver applies irrespective of any law or any provision of a Finance Document to the contrary. 4.5 Appropriations Until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full (and, for the avoidance of doubt, notwithstanding the occurrence of the Separation Effective Date if it occurs prior to such payment in full), the Facility Agent and each other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) may: 4.5.1 refrain from applying or enforcing any other moneys, security or rights held or received by the Facility Agent or that other Finance Party (or any trustee or agent on their respective behalf) in respect of those amounts, or apply and enforce the same in such manner and order as it sees fit (whether against those amounts or otherwise) and the IP Guarantor shall not be entitled to the benefit of the same; and 4.5.2 hold in an interest-bearing suspense account any moneys received from the IP Guarantor, or on account of the IP Guarantor’s liability, in each case, under this IP Guarantee. 4.6 Deferral of the IP Guarantor’s rights Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date (or if earlier, until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full), the IP Guarantor will not exercise any rights which it may have by reason of performance by it of its obligations under this IP Guarantee or by reason of any amount being payable, or liability arising, under this IP Guarantee: 4.6.1 to be indemnified by an Obligor; 4.6.2 to claim any contribution from any other guarantor of any Obligor’s obligations under the Finance Documents; 4.6.3 to take the benefit (in whole or in part and whether by way of subrogation or otherwise) of any rights of the Finance Parties under the Finance Documents or of any other guarantee or security taken pursuant to, or in connection with, the Finance Documents by any Finance Party; 4 4.6.4 to bring legal or other proceedings for an order requiring any Obligor to make any payment, or perform any obligation, in respect of which the IP Guarantor has given a guarantee, undertaking or indemnity under Clause 3 ( Guarantee and indemnity ); 4.6.5 to exercise any right of set-off against any Obligor; and/or 4.6.6 to claim or prove as a creditor of any Obligor in competition with any Finance Party. Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date (or if earlier, until all amounts which may be or become payable by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents have been irrevocably paid in full), if the IP Guarantor receives any benefit, payment or distribution in relation to such rights it shall hold that benefit, payment or distribution to the extent necessary to enable all amounts which may be or become payable to the Finance Parties by the Obligors under or in connection with the Finance Documents to be repaid in full on trust for the Finance Parties and shall promptly pay or transfer the same to the Facility Agent or as the Facility Agent may direct for application in accordance with clause 14 ( Payments ) of the Facility Agreement. 4.7 Additional guarantee This IP Guarantee is in addition to and is not in any way prejudiced by any other guarantee or security now or subsequently held by any Finance Party. 5 Representations and warranties 5.1 Representations and warranties The IP Guarantor makes the representations and warranties set out in this Clause 5 to the Facility Agent (for itself and for the benefit of the other Finance Parties). 5.2 Status (R) It is a corporation duly incorporated and validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of its incorporation, possessing perpetual corporate existence and the capacity to sue and be sued in its own name, and it has the power to own its property and assets and carry on its business as it is now being conducted. It is duly qualified and is licensed and, as applicable, in good standing under the laws of each jurisdiction (other than its jurisdiction of incorporation) where its ownership, lease or operation of properties or the conduct of its business requires such qualification or license, except to the extent that failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.3 Power and authority (R) It has the power to enter into and perform its obligations under this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby and has taken all necessary action to authorise the entry into and performance of its obligations under this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby. 5.4 Legal validity (R) This IP Guarantee constitutes (subject to the Legal Reservations) its legal, valid and binding obligations enforceable in accordance with its terms. 5.5 Non-conflict with laws (R) The entry into and performance by it of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby do not and will not conflict with: 5.5.1 any law or regulation applicable to it; 5 5.5.2 its certificate of incorporation, bylaws or other constitutional documents; or 5.5.3 any agreement or document to which it is a party or which is binding upon it or any of its assets in a manner which is material in the context of this IP Guarantee. 5.6 No default (R) The entry into and performance of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby will not cause an Event of Default to occur. 5.7 Consents All authorisations required in connection with the entry into, performance, validity and enforceability of this IP Guarantee and the transactions contemplated hereby have been obtained or effected and are in full force and effect. 5.8 Governing law and enforcement (R) Subject to the qualifications as to matters of law only expressed in any legal opinion delivered to the Facility Agent pursuant to paragraph (d) of the definition of Legal Reservations: 5.8.1 the choice of English law as the governing law of this IP Guarantee will be recognised and enforced in its jurisdiction of incorporation; and 5.8.2 any judgment obtained in England in relation to this IP Guarantee will be recognised and enforced in its jurisdiction of incorporation. 5.9 Litigation (R) No litigation, arbitration or administrative proceedings (including any relating to Environmental Laws) are current or pending or, to its knowledge, threatened, which are reasonably likely to be adversely determined and which, if so determined, are reasonably likely to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.10 Sanctions 5.10.1 Neither it nor any director, officer or, to the knowledge of the IP Guarantor, any of its employees or representatives in their capacity as such is a Restricted Party. 5.10.2 The IP Guarantor has instituted and maintains policies and procedures designed to promote compliance with Sanctions applicable to it and its business. 5.11 Anti-corruption The IP Guarantor conducts its businesses in compliance with applicable Anti-corruption Laws and has instituted and maintains policies and procedures designed to promote and achieve compliance with such laws. 5.12 ERISA Except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect, the IP Guarantor and its ERISA Affiliates have fulfilled their respective obligations under the minimum funding standards of ERISA and the Code with respect to each Plan and are in compliance in all material respects with the applicable provisions of ERISA and the Code, and have not incurred any liability to the PBGC or any Plan or Multiemployer Plan (other than to make contributions or scheduled payments in the ordinary course of business) which, when taken together with all other such liabilities incurred, would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. 6 5.13 Investment Company Act It is not an "investment company", or a company "controlled" by an "investment company", within the meaning of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended from time to time. 5.14 Times for making representations 5.14.1 The representations set out in this Clause 5 are made by the IP Guarantor on the date of this IP Guarantee. 5.14.2 Up to (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date, the representations and warranties set out in Clauses 5.2 ( Status ) to 5.6 ( No default ) and Clauses 5.8 ( Governing law and enforcement ) and 5.9 ( Litigation ) (and marked for ease of reference with “ (R) ”) shall be deemed to be repeated on the date of delivery of each Request, on each Utilisation Date and on the first day of each Interest Period, with reference to the facts and circumstances then subsisting, as if made at each such time. 5.14.3 When a representation is repeated, it is applied to the circumstances existing at the time of repetition. 6 Undertakings 6.1 Duration The undertakings in this Clause 6 shall remain in force from and after the date of this IP Guarantee until (but excluding) the Separation Effective Date. 6.2 Compliance with laws The IP Guarantor shall comply with all laws to which it is subject, if failure so to comply would have a Material Adverse Effect. 6.3 Pari passu ranking The IP Guarantor undertakes that its obligations under this IP Guarantee will rank at least pari passu in right of priority and payment with all its other present and future unsecured and unsubordinated obligations other than those obligations which are mandatorily preferred by law and not by reason of contract. 6.4 Maintenance of corporate existence The IP Guarantor shall do all such things as are necessary to maintain its corporate existence. 6.5 Know your customer requirements 6.5.1 Subject to Clause 6.5.2 below, the IP Guarantor must promptly on the request of any Finance Party (via the Facility Agent) supply to the Facility Agent (for that Finance Party) any documentation or other evidence which is reasonably requested by that Finance Party (whether for itself, on behalf of any Finance Party or any prospective new Lender) (via the Facility Agent) to enable a Finance Party or prospective new Lender to carry out and be satisfied with the results of all applicable know your customer requirements. 6.5.2 The IP Guarantor shall only be required to supply any information under Clause 6.5.1 above if the necessary information is not already available to the relevant Finance Party and the requirement arises as a result of: 6.5.2.1 th e introduction of any change in (or in the interpretation, administration or application of) any law or regulation made after the date of this IP Guarantee; or 7 6.5.2.2 a proposed assignment or transfer by a Lender of any of its rights and/or obligations under the Facility Agreement to a person that is not a Lender before that assignment or transfer. 6.6 Sanctions and anti-corruption 6.6.1 The IP Guarantor will conduct its business in material compliance with Anti-corruption Laws and Sanctions and will be subject to policies and procedures instituted and maintained by it designed to promote and achieve compliance with such laws. 6.6.2 Any provision in this Clause 6.6 and any provision in Clause 5.10 ( Sanctions ) shall not apply to or in favour of any person if and to the extent that it would result in a breach, by or in respect of that person, of any applicable Blocking Law. 6.6.3 For the purpose of this Clause 6.6, " Blocking Law " means : 6.6.3.1 any provision of Council Regulation (EC) No. 2271/1996 of 22 November 1996 (or any law or regulation implementing such Regulation in any member state of the European Union); 6.6.3.2 any provision of Council Regulation (EC) No. 2271/1996 of 22 November 1996, as it forms part of domestic law of the United Kingdom; or 6.6.3.3 Section 7 of the German Foreign Trade Regulation ( Außenwirtschaftsverordnung ). 7 Remedies and waivers No failure to exercise, nor any delay in exercising, on the part of any Finance Party, any right or remedy under this IP Guarantee shall operate as a waiver, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right or remedy prevent any further or other exercise or the exercise of any other right or remedy. The rights and remedies provided in this IP Guarantee are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights or remedies provided by law. 8 General 8.1 Assignment 8.1.1 Subject to the provisions of the Facility Agreement, the Facility Agent may assign and transfer all or any of its rights and obligations under this IP Guarantee. The IP Guarantor shall not be entitled to assign or transfer all or any of its rights, benefits and obligations under this IP Guarantee without the consent of the Facility Agent (acting on the instructions of each Lender). 8.1.2 Any reference in this IP Guarantee to a Lender includes a New Lender but excludes a Lender if no amount is or may be owed to or by it under the Facility Agreement and its Commitment has been cancelled or reduced to nil. 8.2 Amendments Any amendment to this IP Guarantee must be made in writing and signed by each Party. 8.3 Counterparts This IP Guarantee may be executed in any number of counterparts, and this has the same effect as if the signatures on the counterparts were on a single copy of this IP Guarantee. 8 9 Termination Notwithstanding any other term of this IP Guarantee, with effect upon, from (and including) the Separation Effective Date: 9.1 this IP Guarantee shall automatically , irrevocably and unconditionally terminate (without giving rise to any liabilities of or for the IP Guarantor as a result of such termination) and shall be discharged and cease to be in effect; and 9.2 all of the obligations, liabilities and claims (whether contingent or continuing and including any that have or may have arisen prior to the Separation Effective Date) of or against the IP Guarantor under the terms of, or in connection with, this IP Guarantee shall automatically, irrevocably and unconditionally be terminated, discharged and released (and by countersigning this IP Guarantee, the Facility Agent hereby acknowledges and accepts this Clause 9.2 on behalf of itself and each other Finance Party), provided that Clauses 1.3 ( Third party rights ), 4.5 ( Appropriations ), 10 ( Governing law ), 11 ( Enforcement ) and 13 ( Waiver of jury trial ) shall survive and continue in full force and effect notwithstanding the termination of the other provisions of this IP Guarantee in accordance with this Clause 9 and provided further that in no event shall the IP Guarantor have any obligations or liabilities thereunder or pursuant thereto. For the avoidance of doubt, this Clause 9 is without prejudice to any obligation or liabilities of any Obligor and any claim any Finance Party may have against any Obligor from time to time in accordance with the terms of any Finance Document. 10 Governing law This IP Guarantee and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it are governed by English law. 11 Enforcement 11.1 Jurisdiction 11.1.1 The English courts have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute including a dispute relating to any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with this IP Guarantee. 11.1.2 The English courts are the most appropriate and convenient courts to settle any such dispute and the IP Guarantor waives objection to those courts on the grounds of inconvenient forum or otherwise in relation to proceedings in connection with this IP Guarantee. 11.1.3 This Clause 11.1 is for the benefit of the Finance Parties only. To the extent allowed by law, a Finance Party may take: 11.1.3.1 proceedings in any other court; and 11.1.3.2 concurrent proceedings in any number of jurisdictions. 11.2 Service of process 11.2.1 Without prejudice to any other mode of service allowed under any relevant law, the IP Guarantor: 11.2.1.1 irrevocably appoints International Paper UK Holdings Limited as its agent for service of process in relation to any proceedings before the English courts in connection with this IP Guarantee; and 9 11.2.1.2 agrees that failure by an agent for service of process to notify the IP Guarantor of the process will not invalidate the proceedings concerned. 11.2.2 If any person appointed as process agent is unable for any reason to act as agent for service of process, the IP Guarantor must (provided the Separation Effective Date has not at such time occurred) promptly appoint another agent on terms acceptable to the Facility Agent. Failing this, the Facility Agent may appoint another agent for this purpose. 12 USA Patriot Act 12.1.1 The Facility Agent (on behalf of each Lender that is subject to the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation) hereby notifies the IP Guarantor that, pursuant to the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable, such Lender is required to obtain, verify and record information that identifies the IP Guarantor, which information includes the name and address of the IP Guarantor and other information that will allow such Lender to identify the IP Guarantor in accordance with the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable. The IP Guarantor agrees that it will provide the Facility Agent (on behalf of each Lender) with such information as the relevant Lender may reasonably request in order for such Lender to satisfy the requirements of the USA Patriot Act and/or the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, as applicable. 12.1.2 In this Clause 12: 12.1.2.1 “ Beneficial Ownership Regulation ” means 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230. 12.1.2.2 “ USA Patriot Act ” means the Uniting and Strengthening America by Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism Act of 2001, Public Law 107-56. 13 Waiver of jury trial EACH PARTY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A JURY TRIAL OF ANY CLAIM OR CAUSE OF ACTION IN CONNECTION WITH THIS IP GUARANTEE OR ANY TRANSACTION CONTEMPLATED BY THIS IP GUARANTEE. THIS IP GUARANTEE MAY BE FILED AS A WRITTEN CONSENT TO TRIAL BY COURT.
